description: Every existential sentence in the language of equality alone that has a nonempty model has a nonempty finite model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.existential_empty_language_finite_model.{w} (σ : FirstOrder.Language.empty.Sentence)
  (hσ : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsExistential σ) {M : Type w} [FirstOrder.Language.empty.Structure M]
  [Nonempty M] (hM : M ⊨ σ) : ∃ N x, ∃ (_ : Nonempty N), Finite N ∧ N ⊨ σ
